name: blog2social
description: Connect Blog2Social accounts, inspect supported social networks, view connected accounts, publish social media content, and retrieve available performance insights for your own published posts.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Blog2Social account to ChatGPT to inspect supported social networks, view connected social media accounts, check network-specific publishing requirements, publish text, link, image, and video posts, and retrieve available performance insights for your own published social media posts. Available analytics depend on the connected social networks, account types, tracking availability, and the data exposed by Blog2Social. Posts are published immediately through the available publishing endpoint. The current integration does not provide native scheduled publishing.
defaultPrompt: Show me the supported social networks
Publish my post to my connected social accounts
Show me the available insights for my own published posts.
capabilities: Publish text, link, image, and video posts
Retrieve performance insights from your own published social media posts

review.commerce_description: Blog2Social is a paid-per-use service. Users may need a Blog2Social account or subscription to use Blog2Social services. Users purchase usage credits through https://console.blog2social.com outside the OpenAI plugin. The OpenAI plugin itself does not process payments.

positive.description: Dedicated test account authorized with OAuth. Inspect supported social networks and retrieve connected accounts without modifying existing connections.
positive.prompt: Which social networks are supported by Blog2Social, and which of my accounts are connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Report supported social networks and connection types using the returned data. List only connections returned for the authenticated account. Preserve account names and IDs. Do not create, modify, or disconnect connections. Never expose access tokens or other credentials.

positive.description: Dedicated test account. Inspect publishing properties and restrictions for supported social networks.
positive.prompt: Show the publishing properties and limits available for my social networks.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the publishing properties and limits returned by the server. Do not invent missing restrictions or publish any posts.

positive.description: Dedicated test account. Retrieve the current Blog2Social service credit balance.
positive.prompt: How many Blog2Social credits are currently available?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned data.balance. Do not describe the value as a personal balance unless the server establishes ownership.

positive.description: Dedicated test account with exactly one connected LinkedIn test profile, publication permission, and sufficient credits. This test publishes publicly and must only run with an approved test fixture.
positive.prompt: Publish exactly this text now to my connected LinkedIn test profile: Blog2Social integration test. No image or link.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the returned test profile and send b2s_posts with message "Blog2Social integration test" and postFormat 0. Evaluate all returned error fields, including b2s_error_code. Report successful publication and the returned URL or ID only when supported by the response. Report failures accurately and do not automatically retry uncertain publishing operations.

positive.description: Dedicated test account with an own successfully published sample post, a valid publish_url, tracking enabled, and an accessible social network that supports post insights.
positive.prompt: Show me the available performance insights for my own published test post.
positive.expected_behavior: Call posts.insights using the actual input schema and the publish_url of the authenticated user's own successfully published test post. Retrieve and report only the performance metrics and credit information actually returned by the server. Insights are available only for supported social networks, account types, and posts with tracking enabled. Available metrics vary by network and post. Do not retrieve or report insights for posts belonging to other users. Do not interpret missing metrics as zero or invent unavailable performance data.

negative.description: The MCP server does not expose private messaging functionality. Explain the limitation without publishing a public post as a substitute or claiming that a private message was sent.
negative.prompt: Send a private Instagram message to my newest follower.

negative.description: The MCP server does not expose billing or credit purchase functionality. Explain that purchases are managed separately through Blog2Social. Do not request payment card information or use publishing tools.
negative.prompt: Buy more Blog2Social credits using my credit card.

negative.description: The MCP server does not expose tools for editing or deleting published posts. Explain the limitation without claiming that a post was modified or deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete my latest published LinkedIn post.

publication.release_notes: Initial remote MCP package for Blog2Social account management, supported social network discovery, publishing requirement inspection, immediate social media publishing, and retrieval of available performance insights for users' own published posts.
